description: US Letter pages whose content-stream (text item) order is deliberately scrambled relative to reading order; only geometry recovers it. Page 1: full-width title and abstract over two columns. Page 2: one column stored as third, first, second paragraph.

readingOrder.text: This page stores its paragraphs in a scrambled order.
The first paragraph of the left column is where reading begins
The second paragraph of the left column continues the introduction.
The right column opens with a new section.
In the second paragraph of the right column we note
The first paragraph on this page sits at the top.
The second paragraph lies between the other two
The third paragraph closes the page.
